opening_message:
Ticket 1: Diana Cooper (employee ID E020) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E020.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: admin
  - comment: Diana Cooper (E020) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin access to Source Code. As a full-time employee whose role (Engineer) owns the Source Code system, admin is permitted under policy.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB record for E020 shows contractor with basic security training. Contractors can have at most read (write requires advanced training, admin never permitted). Admin requested exceeds maximum, so grant read.
reason: Security DB record for E020 (Diana Cooper) shows contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors can have at most read (write requires advanced security training, and admin is never permitted for contractors). The requested admin exceeds the maximum, so the maximum allowed level is granted. (Note: the HR note claims full-time Engineer; given the conflicting records, the more restrictive policy-compliant level is applied.)
